description: This file defines the S3EncryptionClient class, which extends the AbstractCryptoClient to provide encryption and decryption functionalities for Amazon S3 objects, including methods for async and sync object upload/download with encryption processing. It is a legacy implementation using an older encryption workflow, wrapping an S3Client with added encryption features.

classes.name: S3EncryptionClient
classes.description: A wrapper client for S3 that encrypts data on upload and decrypts data on download, supporting async operations. It uses traits for cryptographic operations and metadata handling, maintaining legacy encryption workflows.

methods.name: putObjectAsync
methods.description: Encrypts data and uploads an object to S3 asynchronously with promise handling.

methods.name: putObject
methods.description: Encrypts and uploads an object to S3 synchronously.

methods.name: getObjectAsync
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts an object from S3 asynchronously with promise handling.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts an object from S3 synchronously.
